summary: Eastern International Ltd., a Cayman Islands-incorporated NASDAQ-listed freight and cargo arrangement company, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board appointed K. Brice Rick Toussaint and Bin Zhou as directors effective August 18, 2026. Toussaint becomes Audit Committee Chairman and a member of the Nominating/Governance and Compensation Committees; Zhou becomes Compensation Committee Chairman and a member of Audit and Nominating/Governance. Both are deemed independent under NASDAQ Rule 5605(a)(2), with Toussaint an audit committee financial expert. Each receives US$2,500 monthly, payable quarterly, plus expense reimbursement under a director agreement. No arrangements or family relationships were disclosed. This is a routine board-appointment current report, not a special situation.
